description: This file defines a REST API resource for accessing cashier data within the org.apache.fineract project. It exposes an endpoint at /v1/cashiers that returns cashier information based on optional query parameters such as officeId, tellerId, staffId, and date.

classes.name: CashierApiResource
classes.description: A REST controller for retrieving cashier data, annotated as a JAX-RS resource with path /v1/cashiers, integrating with Spring and Swagger for documentation.

methods.name: getCashierData
methods.description: Handles GET HTTP requests to retrieve a collection of CashierData objects, optionally filtered by officeId, tellerId, staffId, and date, with date defaulting to the current business local date if not provided.
